identified_gaps.explanation: Importing GWProt triggers imports from cajal (a native extension). The package requires native compilation and the pip build failed in this environment (Windows) due to missing toolchain/files, preventing GW_protein.make_protein_from_pdb from running and thus blocking creation of the protein objects.
identified_gaps.likely_impact: High — blocks reproduction of the main workflow and the ability to produce GW_protein objects from the provided PDB files; therefore the core claim (that the example can be executed to produce GW_protein objects) cannot be validated here.
identified_gaps.possible_remediation: Install required native build toolchain and dependencies (compilers, build tools, platform-specific libs) or provide prebuilt cajal wheels/conda packages; alternatively run the workflow in a supported Linux environment or container image where cajal builds succeed.
